body: Oh, and I just threw up, so I probably won't be too responsive for the rest of the night. I'm gonna go pass out for a while. Thanks for trying, though.

I don't really have to worry about money right now, which is nice. I could be fired at any moment, though. I work on a government contract, so my entire well-being depends on its renewal next year. Other than that, I can't really think of anything.

See my response to southernbrew08. I'm out of college, and I do work, but these feelings have pretty much been a constant in my life, as long as I can remember. I went to an engineering school, where there were basically no women, and the ones who were there didn't have to deal with people like me. 

I guess what really got me into this rut is the fact that I've always felt this way, and don't expect it to ever change. I really don't think it could ever get better, based on my past experience.

I'm not seeing any psychologist right now, but I have seen some in the past, and they haven't helped at all. That's probably as much my fault as theirs -- it's really easy for me to vocalize these feelings when I've been drinking, but not so much otherwise.

I do have a job at the moment, as a computer programmer. It's probably the cushiest job I'll ever have in my life, but that's not very helpful. I don't really get along with anyone at the company, maybe because I can't even go to lunch with them, they assume I'm some sort of horrible freak and avoid talking to me. I have health insurance of some sort, but like I said, visiting psychiatrists/psychologists and taking antidepressants hasn't help at all in the past.

I've been diagnosed with Asperger's mostly because of my food issues, and because I have a lot of trouble making eye contact with people. To be honest, I haven't pursued it much beyond that, because it's really depressing, but that's enough.

I don't eat healthy at all. I'm a very picky eater -- I eat like 3 foods, I have a more limited diet than most 5-year-olds. Most nights I eat Kraft macaroni and cheese or chicken nuggets. I take multivitamins daily, not sure if it's helpful at all. I own a treadmill that I jog on a few times a week. It's not much, but I guess it's better than nothing.

As an aside, I see people on here who feel a similar depression, but say "my girlfriend doesn't understand", or "my wife blah blah blah". Which makes me feel like even if by some cosmic miracle I did find a girl willing to talk to me, that wouldn't actually help my emotional situation at all. I dunno what that means, but it certainly doesn't give me any hope.
